metadata.title: Groupicorn California IOP/PHP location research
metadata.methodology: Physical-address-first. Local provider groups are considered before named neighboring catchments. Shortlists are editorial discovery candidates, not rankings. September 22, 2026 California weak-area pass added current official or public-agency evidence in selected zero-local and one-local areas; this was not a statewide re-verification. Research only; not a clinical referral directory.
metadata.coverage_target: Nine distinct provider groups per editorial search area, with in-area and neighboring-area candidates separately labeled.
metadata.selection_policy: Research shortlist, not clinical ranking or ordered search-engine results. No paid placement. Does not establish eligibility, availability or proximity.
metadata.coordinate_policy: Null means not collected. Never substitute city or ZIP centroids for a facility pin without a distinct precision value. No distances or drive times have been computed.
metadata.ownership_policy: Same provider brand deduplicated in each shortlist. Two potentially related brand pairs conservatively grouped pending confirmation. Ultimate ownership audit incomplete.
metadata.care_policy: Mental-health, substance-use, co-occurring, eating-disorder and age labels are kept separate. Nine mixed candidates is not nine suitable programs for any particular individual.
